   |
29 |     output.color = input.color * f32(count + 1)
   |                                      ^^^^^^^^^ arithmetic on whole numbers

   = note: the PICA200 vertex unit has no integer ALU; a whole number is only a loop counter or an index
   = help: use `f32`, or keep the number as a loop counter and index only
